title: Euro 2012 Players to Watch: Manuel Neuer of Germany
content: Germany and Bayern Munich’s latest No. 1, Manuel Neuer, succeeded in proving his worth to the latter’s fans this past season. Neuer will be keen to play his part in ensuring the German national side go one better at Euro 2012. In keeping with the fortunes of a club who have not been able to add to their seven German championships since their last success in 1957-58, Neuer alone was unable to help bring the success Schalke fans crave, getting as close as runners-up in his inaugural Bundesliga season and again in 2009-10. One piece of silverware did arrive the following season in the form of the German Cup. Neuer was an ever-present, recording four clean sheets in six rounds (only conceding three goals), two of which came in the semifinals (a 1-0 win over Bayern) and in the 5-0 final demolition of MSV Duisburg. A major hint that his future may lie elsewhere of his hometown club came in the form of Neuer’s elevation to the Germany No. 1 spot.

title: Manuel Neuer starts for Germany in World Cup opener as 40-year-old Bayern goalkeeper features for first time since Euro 2024 - Yahoo Sports
content: # Manuel Neuer starts for Germany in World Cup opener as 40-year-old Bayern goalkeeper features for first time since Euro 2024. Nagelsmann has ended the speculation surrounding his goalkeeping hierarchy by confirming that Neuer will start against Curacao on Sunday. The 40-year-old Bayern Munich icon has recovered from a recent calf injury that saw him miss warm-up friendlies against Finland and the United States, leaving the path clear for him to reclaim his spot between the posts. "All the players are fit and Manu will start," the coach announced in a press conference, while also noting that Nathaniel Brown and Jamal Musiala are also set to feature in the starting XI for the Group E curtain-raiser. Germany enters the tournament as heavy favourites against Curacao, who are participating in their first-ever World Cup. However, Nagelsmann has warned his side against any complacency, noting that opponents with nothing to lose can be the most dangerous. Of course we want to play a good game, but the win is the most important thing for the confidence.".

title: Euro 2012: Germany's Joachim Löw names his 23-man ...
content: Germany' Holger Badstuber, left, Toni Kroos and Thomas Müller enjoy a time-out at their Euro 2012 training camp in Tourrettes, SE France. # Euro 2012: Germany's Joachim Löw names his 23-man squad. Cacau, Marc-Andre ter Stegen, Sven Bender and Julian Draxler have all been left out of Joachim Löw's 23-man selection for Euro 2012. The head coach, who took a 27-man squad into training camps in Sardinia and France, will explain his choices on Tuesday, when he will be working with his final group in the build-up to their first match of the tournament, against Portugal on 9 June. "It was my big goal after the World Cup in South Africa [in 2010] also to be part of Euro 2012 with the Germany national team," Cacau said. Like the younger players, I am also disappointed, but I still feel part of this team and wish them from the bottom of my heart that they play a great European Championship.".

title: Manuel Neuer（German professional football athlete）_Baiduwiki
content: Manuel Neuer (born March 27, 1986, in Gelsenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. He currently plays for FC Bayern Munich in the Bundesliga. At club level, Neuer joined the youth team of FC Schalke 04 in 2001. In 2010, Neuer became the captain of Schalke 04 and helped the team win the DFB-Pokal the following year. From the 2019-20 season to the 2020-21 season, Neuer, as captain, helped Bayern Munich win the Sextuple. At international level, Neuer made his debut for the Germany national football team in 2009. In 2014, he won the 2014 FIFA World Cup Brazil with the German national team and was awarded the World Cup Golden Glove. In May 2026, he returned to the German national team and participated in the 2026 FIFA World Cup with the squad.
